requirement: This code should implement a function block named FB_TripleAxisReset that manages the reset process for three axes (X, Y, Z) using their respective AXIS_REF_SM3 references. The function block should take a boolean input bExecute to start the reset process. It should output three booleans: bDone to indicate if all axes have successfully reset, bBusy to indicate if any axis is still resetting, and bError to indicate if there was an error during the reset process. Additionally, it should output a string sErrorString that contains the error message if an error occurs. The function block should prioritize error handling in the order of X, Y, Z axis. If an error is detected on any axis, it should set bError to TRUE and fetch the error message using the SMC_ERRORSTRING function with the error ID from the respective axis, setting the language to English. If no errors are detected, bError should be set to FALSE and sErrorString should be set to 'CNC_NO_ERROR'.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_TripleAxisReset
VAR_INPUT
	AxisX			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//X轴引用
	AxisY			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Y轴引用
	AxisZ			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Z轴引用
	bExecute		:	BOOL;				//执行复位信号
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bDone			:	BOOL;				//三轴都复位完成
	bBusy			:	BOOL;				//复位进行中
	bError			:	BOOL;				//错误标志
	sErrorString	:	STRING;				//错误信息字符串
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个名为 FB_TripleAxisReset 的功能块，用于管理三个轴（X轴、Y轴、Z轴）的复位过程，这些轴使用各自的 AXIS_REF_SM3 引用。功能块应接受一个布尔输入 bExecute 来启动复位过程。它应输出三个布尔值：bDone 表示所有轴是否已成功复位，bBusy 表示是否有任何轴仍在复位中，bError 表示复位过程中是否出现错误。此外，它应输出一个字符串 sErrorString，如果发生错误，则包含错误消息。功能块应按 X轴、Y轴、Z轴的顺序优先处理错误。如果检测到任何轴的错误，应将 bError 设置为 TRUE，并使用来自相应轴的错误 ID 的 SMC_ERRORSTRING 函数获取错误消息，设置语言为英语。如果没有检测到错误，应将 bError 设置为 FALSE，sErrorString 设置为 'CNC_NO_ERROR'。
